Jeppe Launbjerg is a practicing cardiologist ("Praktiserende kardiolog") affiliated with Hjertelægerne i Hillerød, a cardiology clinic in Hillerød, Denmark [^src1][^src2]. He is named as a member of the steering committee (styregruppen) of AFDK, the Danish national quality database for atrial fibrillation care, appearing in the committee listings of both the 2023 and 2024 annual reports [^src1][^src2]. The 2023 mention appears in a chapter covering the database's data foundation, patient population definitions, data-collection limitations, and steering committee composition, alongside epidemiological and demographic data on atrial fibrillation across Denmark's five regions. The 2024 mention appears in a section documenting patient representatives' perspectives on structured patient education, the implementation of systematic patient education at Hospitalsenhed Midt since 2012, and methodological limitations of the database, within AFDK's role as a nationwide quality database under the Danish Cardiological Society and the Danish Health Authority.

Beyond these two listings, no further biographical detail, relationships, or specific claims about Jeppe Launbjerg are present in the corpus. This is an honest sparse page reflecting the limited available evidence.
